page.hakko-ryu.hero.subtitle: The Eighth Light
page.hakko-ryu.origins.p1: Hakkō-ryū (八光流) is a school of jujutsu founded in 1941 by Okuyama Ryuho (1901–1987), descendant of Daito-ryu and practitioner of shiatsu. The name translates as "The Style of the Eighth Light", referring to the ultraviolet band — invisible yet powerful, like the techniques themselves.
page.hakko-ryu.origins.p2: This humanitarian martial technique focuses on qi meridian points sensitive to pain, allowing defenders to create sharp distracting pain without causing serious injury. True efficiency is invisible to the eyes, just as ultraviolet rays are invisible but very powerful.
page.hakko-ryu.denshin.p1: Hakko Denshin Ryu Jujutsu (八光伝心流柔術) was founded in 1997 by Yasuhiro Irie, Michael LaMonica, and Antonio Garcia — all high-ranking Hakko Ryu practitioners. The name means "Heart and Spirit of Hakko Ryu", known in Japan as Kokodo (皇光道).
page.hakko-ryu.denshin.p2: Each founder became a director ("Soke") in their respective regions (Japan, USA, Europe) and formed the Kokodo Renmei federation. Other descendants include Dentokan Jujutsu founded by Roy Hobbs, and Hakko Densho Ryu founded by Palumbo in Colorado.
page.hakko-ryu.philosophy.quote: "Pain as a tool of distraction, blended with humility and harmony."
page.hakko-ryu.philosophy.p1: Hakko Denshin Ryu is based on the same fundamental principles as traditional Hakko Ryu, enriched with philosophies that promote not only physical strength but also mental resilience and personal growth.
page.hakko-ryu.philosophy.p2: Our curriculum incorporates both unarmed techniques and training with traditional Japanese weapons — the tambo, jo, katana, tanto, sensu, kasa, and many more. These tools symbolize the adaptability and grace inherent in Hakko Denshin Ryu.
page.hakko-ryu.philosophy.p3: At the heart of our practice are datsuryoku (effortless power) and kuzushi (balance breaking). Hakko Denshin Ryu is a philosophy that cultivates confident, humble individuals who embody respect and tradition in all areas of life.
page.hakko-ryu.jujutsu.p1: The term Ju-Jutsu (柔術) refers to disciplines whose efficiency lies in an appropriate and precise gesture whatever the situation may be — not only a self-defense method traceable to the Samurai (侍) period, but also a way of improving oneself through traditional practice.
page.hakko-ryu.jujutsu.p2: Shirobei Akiyama, a doctor from Nagasaki, observed a willow tree during a snowy winter. Its branches bent under the weight of the snow, then sprang back. The cherry tree, which resisted, had its branches broken. From this, Akiyama founded Yoshin Ryu (楊心流) — the non-resistance principle that would shape all jujutsu that followed.
page.hakko-ryu.jujutsu.p3: Around 1600, after centuries of wars, a long era of relative peace was established in Edo. Influenced by Bushido (武士道) and spiritual values, Ju-Jutsu schools became Budo (武道: the Path of Combat) — a support for spiritual improvement.
page.hakko-ryu.jujutsu.p4: More than defeating opponents, Ju-Jutsu develops observation, control, stability, adaptability, respect, and harmony. This is the challenge traditional Ju-Jutsu schools offer in our modern world.
page.hakko-ryu.companion.title: Companion Practices
page.hakko-ryu.companion.shiatsu.descrip: Shi (指) means "finger" and atsu (圧) means "pressure". Shiatsu aims at maintaining or recovering the energetic balance our body needs to be healthy.
page.hakko-ryu.companion.goshin-taiso.de: Goshin (護身) means "protection" and taiso (体操) means "gymnastics". Goshin Taiso is a gymnastic system to maintain the equilibrium of forces in our body — practiced alone for energetic evaluation.
page.hakko-ryu.grades.title: Grading System
page.hakko-ryu.grades.intro: Progress in Hakko Denshin Ryu is marked by three circles of practice — from the first steps on the mat to the teaching ranks. Each belt carries the crest of the school and the name of its circle.

page.senshinkan.about.quote: "The place where you purify your heart — without violence."
page.senshinkan.about.p1: Senshinkan (洗心館) is a dojo where we teach Hakko Denshin Ryu Ju Jutsu (八光伝心流柔術) — a self-defence system without any violence. The name translates as "the place (館) where you purify (洗) your heart/mind (心)".
page.senshinkan.about.p2: The main difference with most other Ju Jutsu styles is the use of wrist locks and Gakun (雅勲) — pressure on kyusho (急所, vital points situated along the meridians).
page.senshinkan.about.p3: The essence of Hakko Denshin Ryu is learning the appropriate and precise gesture, and adopting the right attitude.
page.senshinkan.about.p4: We hope this site will bring you some additional information about our art and inspire you to discover this beautiful martial tradition.
page.senshinkan.bridge.quote: “My old road ended where the new Way began.”
page.senshinkan.romania.title: Senshinkan Romania
page.senshinkan.romania.p1: Senshinkan Romania (洗心館) is a dedicated dojo located in Romania, recognized as an official affiliate of the Hombu Dojo. We train under the supervision of Eric Leempoels Menkyo Kaiden Shihan San Dai Kichu, the Hombu Dojo's official representative in Romania, upholding the integrity of the lineage.
page.senshinkan.romania.p2: Our curriculum incorporates both unarmed techniques and training with traditional Japanese weapons — the tambo, jo, katana, tanto, sensu (fan), kasa (umbrella), walking cane, paper scroll, and many more. These tools symbolize the adaptability and grace inherent in Hakko Denshin Ryu.
page.senshinkan.romania.p3: At the heart of our practice are datsuryoku (effortless power) and kuzushi (balance breaking). Hakko Denshin Ryu is a philosophy that guides decision-making, supports mental well-being, and cultivates confident, humble individuals who embody respect and tradition in all areas of life.
page.dojo.title: Senshinkan Romania
page.dojo.p1: Senshinkan Romania (洗心館) is the official Romanian dojo dedicated to the practice and teaching of Hakko Denshin Ryu Jujutsu. The name "Senshinkan" translates to "Hall of Heart Purification" — reflecting our commitment to both physical training and spiritual development.
page.dojo.p2: Our dojo follows the traditional teachings of Hakko Denshin Ryu, emphasizing the principles of datsuryoku (effortless power) and harmony in both technique and daily life. We maintain direct lineage connections to Eric Leempoels Menkyo Kaiden Shihan San Dai Kichu, ensuring authentic transmission of the art.
page.dojo.p3: Our training environment emphasizes respect, discipline, and mutual growth. Students develop not only effective self-defence techniques but also mental clarity, emotional balance, and spiritual awareness through consistent practice.
page.dojo.offer.title: We offer
page.dojo.offer.techniques: Hakko Denshin Ryu Jujutsu techniques and forms
page.dojo.offer.weapons: Traditional weapons training — tambo, jo, katana, tanto, sensu
page.dojo.closing: Whether you are a beginner seeking the fundamentals of martial arts or an experienced practitioner looking to deepen your understanding, Senshinkan Romania provides a welcoming and traditional environment for your martial arts journey. We honor the legacy of our predecessors while adapting the teachings to serve the needs of modern practitioners.
